title: I vibe-coded GTA on Google Earth over the weekend
author: TrueEstablishment630
selftext:
built crimeworld, a game that lets you:

\- drop into any real city on earth  
\- steal a car, evade real cops, get shot at  
\- in-car radio auto-tunes to real local stations by GPS  
\- planes at every real airport, boats at every real port  
\- respawn at the nearest real hospital when you die

built with Claude Code + Cesium + Google 3D tiles. zero game dev background.

super glitchy for now but playable.

would love feedback on whether you think this idea has legs, and if so where I can take it next. waitlist if you want to follow the build: [cw.naveen.to](http://cw.naveen.to)

comments.author: servia23
comments.body:
Half of the video are full screen headlines => meh.  
Map providers do usually also have the road polylines. You could tell Claude to use that data to know where the car can run and to simulate crashing when it's not over those lines (+ some margin). That way, player won't be able to go across buildings and blablabla.  
(Also never tie the core of your game to a third party provider, once you have it working, you should selfhost, which is also possible by downloading the tiles from OSM)
